question: Why is valproate sodium short, and what do we do?

steps.title: Our stock in three hospitals
steps.purpose: Read on-hand stock and 28-day use where each hospital keeps it.
steps.finding: 5 stock lines across 3 hospitals, 2 presentations, in units of use.

steps.purpose: Read Corvale General's approved interchanges for these items.

steps.finding: 11 stock rows across the system fail the NDC rule; 0 of them are this drug. Every row is in a shared unit of use.

explanation.headline: FDA's records trace our supply to a plant classified OAI 1098 days before the posting

sentences.text: FDA first posted the valproate sodium shortage on 2020-12-30 and it remains Current as of 2026-10-21.
The shortage listing names Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC and Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc. as affected companies.
FDA's OAI classification letter to Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC is dated 2017-12-28, 1098 days before the shortage posting.
Hikma's manufacturing plant (FEI 3002807173) has an OAI inspection from 2014 and multiple VAI inspections through 2023.
Corvale East has 3.8 days of the 100 mg/mL 5 mL presentation on hand while Corvale General has 14.9 days.
The rule-ranked option is to transfer 3 vials of 100 mg/mL 5 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East, which would give Corvale East 5 days of supply while Corvale General retains two weeks.

rejected.text: Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC also received a VAI classification 506 days before the posting and another VAI 299 days before the posting.
rejected.reason: Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC is not in the cited evidence

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
